metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since they loved Inside Out 2, they will enjoy seeing how Riley's core emotions first learned to work together in this wonderful prequel.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A heartwarming and visually stunning Pixar story about elements finding connection, perfect for fans of Inside Out's emotional depth.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: A hilarious and sweet follow-up to Finding Nemo, focusing on everyone's favorite forgetful blue tang fish searching for her parents.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: They will love seeing how Mike and Sulley first met, clashed, and ultimately became best friends in college in this fun prequel to Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they have already watched and enjoyed Frozen II, this original magical musical adventure with Elsa and Anna is a must-watch.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: The timeless Disney classic that started it all, perfect for fans of Simba's Pride and the 2024 Mufasa film.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Completes the trilogy of Po's awesome martial arts adventures with plenty of humor, heart, and stunning animation.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: More Minion mischief, hilarious spy action, and family bonding for fans who loved the original Despicable Me.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Introduces Gru's long-lost twin brother Dru in another highly entertaining, fast-paced family comedy.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud spin-off dedicated entirely to the silly yellow Minions on their quest to find a villainous master to serve.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A super-fun, action-packed comedy about a supervillain who accidentally defeats his hero and has to reinvent his life purpose.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A fantastic, action-packed superhero comedy about a family trying to live a normal suburban life while secretly saving the world.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: An exciting sequel focusing on Elastigirl's heroics in the spotlight while Mr. Incredible hilariously manages the kids at home.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: An imaginative, retro video game-themed adventure that fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie will absolutely adore.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: Ralph and Vanellope explore the wild, vast world of the internet in this hilarious and heartwarming modern sequel.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful, gentle Pixar movie about friendship and sea monsters disguised as humans on the scenic Italian coast.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: An exciting fantasy road-trip adventure about two elf brothers trying to spend one last magical day with their late father.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A cute and funny look at what our animal companions get up to when their owners leave for school or work each day.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets 2
metas.description: More funny animal antics and heartwarming personal growth for Max, Gidget, and the heroic bunny Snowball.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming, extremely kind-hearted family comedy about a polite, clumsy bear from Peru adjusting to London life.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An absolute masterpiece of family cinema with endless humor, warmth, and a delightful, marmalade-loving hero.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliant, silent-comedy style claymation adventure from Aardman, the incredible creators of Chicken Run.

metas.name: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
metas.description: A hilarious sci-fi twist for Shaun and his barnyard friends as they help a cute, mischievous alien return to her home planet.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: The highly-anticipated sequel to Chicken Run, offering more exciting, high-stakes avian heist adventures.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A beautifully animated, wholesome, and sweet adventure with Snoopy, Charlie Brown, and the rest of the beloved gang.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful and adventurous Pixar classic about an elderly man and a young Wilderness Explorer floating away in a balloon-powered house.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A high-octane, fun Pixar favorite about hotshot race car Lightning McQueen learning what it truly means to be a teammate.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A colorful, action-packed prehistoric adventure about a cave-dwelling family discovering a massive, fantastical new world.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: A wildly funny sequel where the prehistoric Croods clash and team up with a more advanced, modern family.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-filled, heartwarming Disney adventure featuring Baymax, the most lovable healthcare companion robot ever created.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A gorgeous Studio Ghibli adaptation of 'The Borrowers' concept, perfect for kids who enjoyed the 1997 live-action film.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical, lighthearted Studio Ghibli fantasy adventure that fans of Kiki's Delivery Service and Totoro will adore.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: The thrilling and comedic backstory of the legendary hero Puss in Boots before his adventures in The Last Wish.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A heartwarming, musical adventure about a young girl helping a magical, music-loving Yeti return to his home on Mount Everest.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical Disney musical that celebrates the power of courage and making a wish upon a star, ideal for classic Disney fans.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A clever, warm animated fantasy about a young boy overcoming his fears with the help of the literal embodiment of the Dark.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A highly entertaining, musical comedy about a 74-year-old class lizard who helps elementary school kids navigate their worries.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic, heartwarming fantasy adventure about an underdog Viking boy who secretly befriends a legendary dragon named Toothless.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: An incredible, high-flying sequel that expands the world of dragons and Vikings with breathtaking action and deep emotion.
